answer: Bindings are kept in nebula, verified in lotus, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the fable check. A farm of 2830 identities would post 1983 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
